name: database-manager
description: Merge multiple files into one Excel database with duplicate detection, schema-based columns, and multilingual support for Windows.

paragraphs: Welcome to database-manager! This application helps you combine multiple Excel, CSV, TXT, and vCard files into a single, organized Excel database. It's perfect for managing contacts, product lists, student records, or any custom data you work with.
features: Combine Excel (.xlsx), CSV, TXT, and vCard files into one master database. No limits on how many files you can merge.
Every row in your merged database includes a column showing which original file it came from. Perfect for auditing and organization.
The app automatically finds and highlights duplicate entries across your combined files. You can review them before finalizing your database.
Whether you're working with contacts (name, phone, email), products (SKU, price, stock), students (ID, grade, attendance), or custom schemas, database-manager adjusts its columns to match your needs.
Switch between Uzbek, Russian, and English with a simple click. The entire interface is translated.
